description: This Java test class 'DatabaseDetectiveIT' contains integration tests for the 'DatabaseDetective' class in the OpenMRS project. It tests whether the database is empty, contains tables, or contains only Liquibase changelog tables, by executing setup and test methods using JUnit 5.

classes.name: DatabaseDetectiveIT
classes.description: Integration test class for 'DatabaseDetective' to verify database state detection logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes 'DatabaseDetective' instance and properties object before each test.

methods.name: shouldRecogniseDatabaseWithoutAnyTables
methods.description: Tests that the database is recognized as empty when no tables are present.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreLiquibaseChangeLogTables
methods.description: Ensures that Liquibase changelog tables are ignored and the database is recognized as empty.

methods.name: shouldRecogniseDatabaseContainsOpenmrsTables
methods.description: Verifies detection when the database contains OpenMRS specific tables.
